description: Finds Horizon's country, regional and global destinations by English name, slug or ISO country code, for a destination whose name is unclear or a trip through several countries. With coveringCountries (ISO-3 codes) it returns only the destinations that cover every country of the itinerary. Returns each destination's name, slug and type, without prices.

coveringCountries.description: ISO-3 country codes, for example FRA and DEU.

name: search_destinations
title: Find Horizon destinations
